text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The victor was Mihono Bourbon. The goal of 
achieving the Triple Crown had crumbled 
away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Machikane Tannhauser stayed 
positive, wishing to use what she learned 
from today's race to give it her all in 
the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Rice Shower, who had also 
suffered defeat, seemed even more fired 
up, telling herself, "I've still gotta do 
my best!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Classic year is far from over. Our 
days of running full tilt toward the 
upcoming Japan Derby continue!
